versos.hebraico: אָ֣ז יָשִֽׁיר־מֹשֶׁה֩ וּבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אָשִׁ֤ירָה לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃

controles.web: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said,  “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. The horse and his rider he has thrown into the sea.
controles.kjv: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
controles.livre: Então cantou Moisés e os filhos de Israel este cântico ao SENHOR, e disseram: Cantarei eu ao SENHOR, porque se triunfou grandemente, Lançando no mar ao cavalo e ao que nele subia.

versos.hebraico: עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֔הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה זֶ֤ה אֵלִי֙ וְאַנְוֵ֔הוּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י אָבִ֖י וַאֲרֹמְמֶֽנְהוּ׃

controles.web: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
controles.kjv: The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
controles.livre: O SENHOR é minha força, e minha canção, E foi-me por salvação: Este é meu Deus, e a este engrandecerei; Deus de meu pai, e a este exaltarei.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yahweh is a man of war. Yahweh is his name.
controles.kjv: The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name.
controles.livre: O SENHOR, homem de guerra; o SENHOR é seu nome.

versos.hebraico: מַרְכְּבֹ֥ת פַּרְעֹ֛ה וְחֵיל֖וֹ יָרָ֣ה בַיָּ֑ם וּמִבְחַ֥ר שָֽׁלִשָׁ֖יו טֻבְּע֥וּ בְיַם־סֽוּף׃

controles.web: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
controles.kjv: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
controles.livre: Os carros de Faraó e a seu exército lançou no mar; E seus escolhidos príncipes foram afundados no mar Vermelho.

versos.hebraico: תְּהֹמֹ֖ת יְכַסְיֻ֑מוּ יָרְד֥וּ בִמְצוֹלֹ֖ת כְּמוֹ־אָֽבֶן׃

controles.web: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.
controles.kjv: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
controles.livre: Os abismos os cobriram; Como pedra desceram aos profundos.

versos.hebraico: יְמִֽינְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה נֶאְדָּרִ֖י בַּכֹּ֑חַ יְמִֽינְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה תִּרְעַ֥ץ אוֹיֵֽב׃

controles.web: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
controles.kjv: Thy right hand, O Lord, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O Lord, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
controles.livre: Tua mão direita, ó SENHOR, foi engrandecida em força; Tua mão direita, ó SENHOR, quebrantou ao inimigo.

versos.hebraico: וּבְרֹ֥ב גְּאוֹנְךָ֖ תַּהֲרֹ֣ס קָמֶ֑יךָ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ חֲרֹ֣נְךָ֔ יֹאכְלֵ֖מוֹ כַּקַּֽשׁ׃

controles.web: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.
controles.kjv: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
controles.livre: E com a grandeza de tua poder transtornaste aos que se levantaram contra ti: Enviaste teu furor; os tragou como o restolho.

versos.hebraico: וּבְר֤וּחַ אַפֶּ֨יךָ֙ נֶ֣עֶרְמוּ מַ֔יִם נִצְּב֥וּ כְמוֹ־נֵ֖ד נֹזְלִ֑ים קָֽפְא֥וּ תְהֹמֹ֖ת בְּלֶב־יָֽם׃

controles.web: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.
controles.kjv: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
controles.livre: Com o sopro de tuas narinas se amontoaram as águas; Pararam-se as correntezas como em um amontoado; Os abismos se solidificaram em meio do mar.

versos.hebraico: אָמַ֥ר אוֹיֵ֛ב אֶרְדֹּ֥ף אַשִּׂ֖יג אֲחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָ֑ל תִּמְלָאֵ֣מוֹ נַפְשִׁ֔י אָרִ֣יק חַרְבִּ֔י תּוֹרִישֵׁ֖מוֹ יָדִֽי׃

controles.web: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire shall be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.’
controles.kjv: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
controles.livre: O inimigo disse: Perseguirei, prenderei, repartirei despojos; Minha alma se encherá deles; Tirarei minha espada, minha mão os destruirá.

versos.hebraico: נָשַׁ֥פְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ֖ כִּסָּ֣מוֹ יָ֑ם צָֽלֲלוּ֙ כַּֽעוֹפֶ֔רֶת בְּמַ֖יִם אַדִּירִֽים׃

controles.web: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
controles.kjv: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
controles.livre: Sopraste com teu vento, cobriu-os o mar: Afundaram-se como chumbo nas impetuosas águas.

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃

controles.web: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
controles.kjv: Who is like unto thee, O Lord, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
controles.livre: Quem como tu, SENHOR, entre os deuses? Quem como tu, magnífico em santidade, Terrível em louvores, autor de maravilhas?

versos.hebraico: נָטִ֨יתָ֙ יְמִ֣ינְךָ֔ תִּבְלָעֵ֖מוֹ אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.
controles.kjv: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
controles.livre: Estendeste a tua mão direita; a terra os tragou.

versos.hebraico: נָחִ֥יתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ עַם־ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ נֵהַ֥לְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֖ אֶל־נְוֵ֥ה קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃

controles.web: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
controles.kjv: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
controles.livre: Conduziste em tua misericórdia a este povo, ao qual salvaste; Levaste-o com tua força à habitação de teu santuário.

versos.hebraico: שָֽׁמְע֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים יִרְגָּז֑וּן חִ֣יל אָחַ֔ז יֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּלָֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold on the inhabitants of Philistia.
controles.kjv: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
controles.livre: Ouviram-no os povos, e tremerão; Dor se apoderará dos moradores da filístia.

versos.hebraico: אָ֤ז נִבְהֲלוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אֵילֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב יֹֽאחֲזֵ֖מוֹ רָ֑עַד נָמֹ֕גוּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י כְנָֽעַן׃

controles.web: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan are melted away.
controles.kjv: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
controles.livre: Então os príncipes de Edom se perturbarão; Aos robustos de Moabe os ocupará tremor; Todos os moradores de Canaã se abaterão.

versos.hebraico: תִּפֹּ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם אֵימָ֨תָה֙ וָפַ֔חַד בִּגְדֹ֥ל זְרוֹעֲךָ֖ יִדְּמ֣וּ כָּאָ֑בֶן עַד־יַעֲבֹ֤ר עַמְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה עַֽד־יַעֲבֹ֖ר עַם־ז֥וּ קָנִֽיתָ׃

controles.web: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone— until your people pass over, Yahweh, until the people pass over who you have purchased.
controles.kjv: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O Lord, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.
controles.livre: Caia sobre eles tremor e espanto; À grandeza de teu braço emudeçam como uma pedra; Até que tenha passado teu povo, ó SENHOR, Até que tenha passado este povo que tu resgataste.

versos.hebraico: תְּבִאֵ֗מוֹ וְתִטָּעֵ֨מוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְךָ֔ מָכ֧וֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ֛ פָּעַ֖לְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה מִקְּדָ֕שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖י כּוֹנְנ֥וּ יָדֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You shall bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, Yahweh, which you have made for yourself to dwell in; the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O Lord, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.
controles.livre: Tu os introduzirás e os plantarás no monte de tua herança, No lugar de tua morada, que tu preparaste, ó SENHOR; No santuário do Senhor, que firmaram tuas mãos.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֥ה׀ יִמְלֹ֖ךְ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

controles.web: Yahweh shall reign forever and ever.”
controles.kjv: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.
controles.livre: O SENHOR reinará pelos séculos dos séculos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י בָא֩ ס֨וּס פַּרְעֹ֜ה בְּרִכְבּ֤וֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו֙ בַּיָּ֔ם וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵהֶ֖ם אֶת־מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃פ

controles.web: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahweh brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the midst of the sea.
controles.kjv: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the Lord brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
controles.livre: Porque Faraó entrou cavalgando com seus carros e seus cavaleiros no mar, e o SENHOR voltou a trazer as águas do mar sobre eles; mas os filhos de Israel foram a seco por meio do mar.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּקַּח֩ מִרְיָ֨ם הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֲח֧וֹת אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־הַתֹּ֖ף בְּיָדָ֑הּ וַתֵּצֶ֤אןָ כָֽל־הַנָּשִׁים֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יהָ בְּתֻפִּ֖ים וּבִמְחֹלֹֽת׃

controles.web: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.
controles.kjv: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
controles.livre: E Miriã a profetisa, irmã de Arão, tomou um pandeiro em sua mão, e todas as mulheres saíram atrás dela com pandeiros e danças.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּ֥עַן לָהֶ֖ם מִרְיָ֑ם שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃ס

controles.web: Miriam answered them,  “Sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. The horse and his rider he has thrown into the sea.”
controles.kjv: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
controles.livre: E Miriã lhes respondia: Cantai ao SENHOR; porque em extremo se engrandeceu, Lançando no mar ao cavalo, e ao que nele subia.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּסַּ֨ע מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִיַּם־ס֔וּף וַיֵּצְא֖וּ אֶל־מִדְבַּר־שׁ֑וּר וַיֵּלְכ֧וּ שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת־יָמִ֛ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְלֹא־מָ֥צְאוּ מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
controles.kjv: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
controles.livre: E fez Moisés que partisse Israel do mar Vermelho, e saíram ao deserto de Sur; e andaram três dias pelo deserto sem achar água.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ מָרָ֔תָה וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לִשְׁתֹּ֥ת מַ֨יִם֙ מִמָּרָ֔ה כִּ֥י מָרִ֖ים הֵ֑ם עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־שְׁמָ֖הּ מָרָֽה׃

controles.web: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.
controles.kjv: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
controles.livre: E chegaram a Mara, e não puderam beber as águas de Mara, porque eram amargas; por isso lhe puseram o nome de Mara.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּלֹּ֧נוּ הָעָ֛ם עַל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹ֖ר מַה־נִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃

controles.web: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”
controles.kjv: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
controles.livre: Então o povo murmurou contra Moisés, e disse: Que beberemos?

versos.hebraico: וַיִּצְעַ֣ק אֶל־יְהוָ֗ה וַיּוֹרֵ֤הוּ יְהוָה֙ עֵ֔ץ וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶל־הַמַּ֔יִם וַֽיִּמְתְּק֖וּ הַמָּ֑יִם שָׁ֣ם שָׂ֥ם ל֛וֹ חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וְשָׁ֥ם נִסָּֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them;
controles.kjv: And he cried unto the Lord; and the Lord shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
controles.livre: E Moisés clamou ao SENHOR; e o SENHOR lhe mostrou uma árvore, a qual quando a meteu dentro das águas, as águas se tornaram doces. Ali lhes deu estatutos e ordenanças, e ali os provou;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אִם־שָׁמ֨וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַ֜ע לְק֣וֹל׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ וְהַיָּשָׁ֤ר בְּעֵינָיו֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְהַֽאֲזַנְתָּ֙ לְמִצְוֺתָ֔יו וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֖ כָּל־חֻקָּ֑יו כָּֽל־הַמַּֽחֲלָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֤מְתִּי בְמִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לֹא־אָשִׂ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֹפְאֶֽךָ׃ס

controles.web: and he said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you, which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”
controles.kjv: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee.
controles.livre: E disse: Se ouvires atentamente a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, e fizeres o correto diante de seus olhos, e deres ouvido a seus mandamentos, e guardares todos os seus estatutos, nenhuma enfermidade das que enviei aos egípcios te enviarei a ti; porque eu sou o SENHOR que te sara.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵילִ֔מָה וְשָׁ֗ם שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֖יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים תְּמָרִ֑ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־שָׁ֖ם עַל־הַמָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
controles.kjv: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
controles.livre: E chegaram a Elim, onde havia doze fontes de águas, e setenta palmeiras; e assentaram ali junto às águas.
